columns.label: Attachment ID
columns.reason: Identifies the attachment and is useful to copy into AWS operations.

columns.label: Resource type
columns.reason: Distinguishes the kind of resource attached.

columns.label: State
columns.reason: Shows the attachment's current lifecycle status.

columns.label: Transit gateway ID
columns.reason: Shows which transit gateway the attachment belongs to.

reason: The schema provides no resource name, so the attachment ID is the clearest primary identifier; resource type, resource ID, state, gateway ID, and creation time are concise operational fields.
